006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import java.util.Collections;
009import java.util.EnumSet;
010import java.util.List;
011import java.util.Set;
012
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.impl.AbstractFunction;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.ISequenceType;
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
021
022/**
023 * Provides a concrete implementation of a function call executor.
024 */
025public class DefaultFunction
026    extends AbstractFunction {
027  // private static final Logger logger =
028  // LogManager.getLogger(AbstractFunction.class);
029
030  @NonNull
031  private final Set<FunctionProperty> properties;
032  @NonNull
033  private final ISequenceType result;
034  @NonNull
035  private final IFunctionExecutor handler;
036
037  /**
038   * Construct a new function signature.
039   *
040   * @param name
041   *          the name of the function
042   * @param properties
043   *          the characteristics of the function
044   * @param arguments
045   *          the argument signatures or an empty list
046   * @param result
047   *          the type of the result
048   * @param handler
049   *          the handler to call to execute the function
050   */
051  @SuppressWarnings({ "null", "PMD.LooseCoupling" })
052  DefaultFunction(
053      @NonNull String name,
054      @NonNull String namespace,
055      @NonNull EnumSet<FunctionProperty> properties,
056      @NonNull List<IArgument> arguments,
057      @NonNull ISequenceType result,
058      @NonNull IFunctionExecutor handler) {
059    super(name, namespace, arguments);
060    this.properties = Collections.unmodifiableSet(properties);
061    this.result = result;
062    this.handler = handler;
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  public Set<FunctionProperty> getProperties() {
067    return properties;
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  public ISequenceType getResult() {
072    return result;
073  }
074
075  @Override
076  public boolean isNamedFunction() {
077    return true;
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Execute the provided function using the provided arguments, dynamic context,
082   * and focus.
083   *
084   * @param arguments
085   *          the function arguments
086   * @param dynamicContext
087   *          the dynamic evaluation context
088   * @param focus
089   *          the current focus item in the evaluation context. This represents
090   *          the context item for anonymous function evaluation. May be null for
091   *          functions that don't require context item access.
092   * @return a sequence containing the result of the execution
093   * @throws MetapathException
094   *           if an error occurred while executing the function
095   */
096  @Override
097  @NonNull
098  protected ISequence<?> executeInternal(
099      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
100      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
101      @Nullable IItem focus) {
102    return handler.execute(this, arguments, dynamicContext, focus);
103  }
104}
